faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our travel services, bookings, payments, and more.
faq.metaTitle: FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions | JetSet Travel Cyprus
faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about booking, payment, cancellation, corporate accounts, visas, and our 24/7 support.

booking.q1: How do I request a travel quote?
booking.a1: Contact us via our website form, WhatsApp (+357 99 478 073), or email (info@jetset.com.cy). Tell us your destination, dates, number of travelers, and preferences. We typically respond with options within 24 hours.
booking.q2: What services does JetSet Travel offer?
booking.a2: We provide corporate travel management, luxury leisure travel planning, flight and hotel bookings, visa assistance, private transfers, and 24/7 travel disruption support.
booking.a3: Yes. We manage group travel for corporate events, team retreats, and large family trips. We handle logistics, coordinated bookings, and negotiate group rates.
booking.a4: Absolutely. We have access to real-time availability and can arrange urgent travel. Contact us via WhatsApp for the fastest response.

corporate.q1: How does your corporate travel management work?
corporate.a1: We assign a dedicated account manager to your company. They handle all bookings, ensure policy compliance, provide clean invoicing for finance teams, and offer 24/7 disruption support.
corporate.a2: Yes. We provide detailed, finance-ready invoices aligned with corporate compliance requirements. Monthly statements and reporting are available for corporate accounts.
corporate.q3: What happens if there's a travel disruption?
corporate.a3: Our 24/7 support team handles rebooking, rerouting, and real-time updates via WhatsApp. We manage the disruption so your team can focus on their work.

payments.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.a1: We accept bank transfers and major credit/debit cards. Payment terms for corporate accounts can be arranged.
payments.a2: Cancellation terms vary depending on the supplier (airline, hotel, etc.). We always communicate specific terms before confirming any booking. Some bookings are non-refundable — we will make this clear upfront.
payments.a3: Travel insurance is not included but strongly recommended. We can help you find appropriate coverage for your trip.

visa.q1: What visa services do you provide?
visa.a1: We provide document checklists, application guidance, and coordination support for business and tourist visas to most countries.
visa.a2: No. Visa approval is at the discretion of the issuing authority. We maximize your chances by ensuring complete and accurate applications.
visa.q3: How long does visa processing take?
visa.a3: Processing times vary by country and visa type. Typical processing is 5–15 business days. We recommend applying at least 4–6 weeks before travel.

about.a1: Yes. We are a fully accredited IATA travel agent and hold Cyprus Tourism Organisation Licence #7775.
about.a2: 26A Agapinoros, 8049 Paphos, Cyprus. Office hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM (lunch break 1:00–3:00 PM).

aboutPage.storyTitle: From a Small Office in Paphos to a Nationwide Partner
aboutPage.storyP1: JetSet Travel was founded in 2006 with a simple belief: travel should be personal, transparent, and handled by people who genuinely care about getting it right.
aboutPage.storyP2: What started as a two-person office in Paphos has grown into one of Cyprus's most trusted travel agencies — serving corporate clients, luxury travellers, and families across the island. Over 20 years later, that founding principle hasn't changed.
aboutPage.storyP3: We hold full IATA accreditation and are licensed by the Cyprus Tourism Organisation, giving our clients the confidence that their bookings are protected, compliant, and competitively priced.

corporatePage.heroTitle: Corporate Travel Management That Works for Your Finance Team
corporatePage.heroSubtitle: IATA-accredited agency in Cyprus delivering fast quotes, clean invoices, and 24/7 support for businesses that need travel done right.
corporatePage.whySubtitle: Three pillars that make corporate travel effortless for your team and transparent for your finance department.
corporatePage.speedDesc: Fast quotes within 30 minutes during business hours. Last-minute itinerary changes handled in real time.
corporatePage.complianceDesc: Full VAT-compliant invoicing, travel policy enforcement, and detailed expense reporting for every trip.
corporatePage.reliabilityDesc: 24/7 emergency support line for travellers abroad. Dedicated account manager for your organisation.
corporatePage.howSubtitle: From onboarding to your first trip — we make the process seamless.
corporatePage.step1Desc: Share your travel policy, preferred airlines, hotel tiers, and budget guidelines.
corporatePage.step2Desc: A dedicated account manager sets up your company profile with negotiated rates and approval workflows.
corporatePage.step3Desc: Request trips via email, phone, or WhatsApp. We handle booking, ticketing, and confirmations.
corporatePage.step4Desc: Travellers receive full itineraries. Finance gets clean invoices and monthly spending reports.
corporatePage.coverSubtitle: A full-service corporate travel solution — everything your business needs under one roof.
corporatePage.faq1A: Yes. Every booking comes with a detailed, VAT-compliant invoice suitable for EU tax reporting. We can also provide consolidated monthly invoices for easier accounting and integrate with your expense management system.
corporatePage.faq2Q: Can you enforce our company travel policy?
corporatePage.faq2A: Absolutely. During onboarding we configure your policy rules — preferred airlines, hotel star ratings, cabin classes, and budget caps. Our system flags any out-of-policy requests for approval before booking.
corporatePage.faq3Q: How do you handle urgent or last-minute bookings?
corporatePage.faq3A: We offer 24/7 emergency support for corporate clients. Urgent requests are prioritised, and our IATA-accredited status means we can issue tickets instantly without waiting for third-party confirmations.
corporatePage.faq4Q: What is your cancellation and rebooking policy?
corporatePage.faq4A: We manage all cancellations and changes on your behalf at no additional service fee. You only pay any airline or hotel penalties that apply. We also proactively monitor fare changes and rebook when savings are available.

visaPage.heroSubtitle: Navigating visa requirements can be stressful. We handle the paperwork, appointments, and follow-ups so you can focus on your trip.
visaPage.destSubtitle: Processing times and difficulty levels for the most requested visas from Cyprus.
visaPage.howSubtitle: A simple four-step process from enquiry to approved visa.
visaPage.step1Desc: Share where you're going, your nationality, and travel dates. We assess the requirements immediately.
visaPage.step2Desc: We provide a personalised checklist and review every document before submission to avoid delays.
visaPage.step3Desc: We submit your application to the embassy or visa centre, handling forms, fees, and appointment scheduling.
visaPage.step4Desc: Once approved, we arrange collection and send you a confirmation. You're ready to fly.
visaPage.checklistSubtitle: Prepare these documents before your visa consultation. The exact requirements vary by destination.
visaPage.checklistNote: This is a general checklist. We will provide a personalised list based on your nationality and destination after your initial consultation.
visaPage.disclaimer: JetSet Travel Cyprus assists with visa application preparation and submission. Final visa decisions are made solely by the respective embassy or consulate. We do not guarantee visa approval. Processing times are estimates and may vary based on embassy workload, seasonality, and individual circumstances.
